title: Zesty Yeasty Malaysian Cashew Noodles
description: A yeasty and glassy-jelly Malaysian dish featuring cashews, with an al-dente finish, this recipe is a nostalgic and raw-friendly option. It combines the flavors of Malaysia with the crunch of cashews.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions until they are al-dente.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped cashews and cook until they are lightly toasted.
Add the yeast extract, soy sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, and garlic to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional cashews and lime wedges if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the noodles in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
